issues.title: Truncated Log Shipping Contract
issues.why: The file 06-log-shipping-contract.md is truncated mid-sentence due to the 90KB context cap, leaving the core payload schema and streaming wire-format details missing.
issues.fix: Move the normative JSON payload examples and NDJSON framing rules from the end of file 06 to a new file 10-payload-examples.md to stay under the per-file cap.

issues.title: Unresolved Server-Side Gaps
issues.why: The consistency report (§99) explicitly lists GAP-22-03 and GAP-22-04, noting that the receiving server spec (folder 22) does not yet define the NDJSON format or the PreviousHasError field.
issues.fix: Update spec/22/04 to include the 'PreviousHasError' boolean in the Ack schema and define the NDJSON streaming framing.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'RepoRoot' derivation
issues.why: Config §05 mentions 'root_repo' is auto-derived by stripping -vN, but doesn't specify if this is regex-based or suffix-based, which could lead to inconsistent RepoUrl keys.
issues.fix: Define root_repo derivation as: strip suffix matching regex '-v[0-9]+$' from the repository name.
